title: SIGHT
description: A lightweight Fabric modpack that makes Minecraft visually stunning with shaders & effects.
body:
# SIGHT – The Stunning Minecraft Project (Fabric 1.21.6)

**SIGHT is a lightweight yet visually breathtaking Minecraft modpack designed to transform the game’s visuals without changing core gameplay. Built on Fabric 1.21.6 with full shader support, this pack enhances your world with cinematic lighting, realistic soundscapes, better foliage, smoother animations, and immersive environmental detail — all while keeping performance smooth.

Whether you’re wandering through a foggy forest lit by fireflies or watching light reflect off a quiet lake, SIGHT makes every moment feel like a movie.
**
Features:

- Full shader support using Iris + Sodium (use shaders like Complementary or BSL)

- Enhanced visuals: glowing effects, fireflies, falling leaves, water splashes

- Sound upgrades: reverb, echo, ambient environmental audio

- Smooth third-person 

- Optimized with Sodium, Lithium, and other performance-boosting mods
 
- Full resource pack support:connected textures, custom skies
 
- Recommended Add-ons:
 
- Shader packs: Complementary Reimagined, BSL
 
- Resource packs: Fresh Animations, Dramatic Skys
 
Notes:

This is a visual modpack only. It does not add gameplay changes or major content mods.

All included mods are either hosted on Modrinth or use modpack-friendly licenses.

License:  Apache-2.0

If you want Minecraft to look like a AAA indie game while keeping the vanilla feel intact, SIGHT is your answer.
